messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: synth-canary-eu-west failing threshold (90%+ 5xx) — page fired to #incidents and @eric_sre oncall. probe_id=canary-eu-west-7, runbook: https://go/runbooks/synth-canary

pagerduty: Incident #PD-83421 created — urgent, unacknowledged. Escalation policy: eu-synth -> oncall-sre -> ops_lead

eric_sre: ack'd — looking now. quick check: is this across all canaries or single probe?

jane_platform: I see a surge of 502/504 from the eu-west probe group in the synthetic dashboard. beginning ~1799998840. volume ~120 failures / 1m window.

alex_prodeng: any customer reports? I can't find errors in public API logs for the last 10m. most user calls are 200 but latency bumped for a subset.

maria_oncall: I got a PD page — hopping on. running manual probe: ```
curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}s" https://synth-prober-eu1.redwood-internal/probe/canary-eu-west-7
```

maria_oncall: result: `502 0.12s`, repeated 5/5 right now.

eric_sre: thanks. checking edge logs and LB health. suspicion: backend pool returning 502s, maybe an upstream timeout.

jane_platform: KV: the prober's request path hits the routing layer -> inference runtime pool A (eu-west-a). 502s from runtime nodes reported starting 1799998838.

ops_lead: if runtime nodes are failing we should consider failover to eu-west-b. prepare to flip routing if needed.

eric_sre: running `kubectl -n runtime logs -l app=inference-runtime -p --since=5m` on eu-west-a. seeing lots of "stream reset" + `out_of_memory` traces on a few pods. suspect oom/GC spikes after a recent config roll.

alex_prodeng: rollback candidate: config map `runtime-config:v2026-03-12` changed tokenizer cache settings. could be related.

jane_platform: also seeing increased queue times — backlog causing 502 bursts.

eric_sre: mitigation plan: 1) scale up runtime node group eu-west-a (+20%), 2) temporarily route traffic to eu-west-b for synth probes only, 3) pause the noisy synth check to reduce churn.

maria_oncall: executing step 2: `redwood route update --service prober --region eu-west --target eu-west-b --filter synth=true` — patching now.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Route update accepted and applied (change_id=chg-89234). Synth probes now hitting eu-west-b.

maria_oncall: re-running manual probe: got `200 0.06s` from eu-west-b for 3/3 attempts.

eric_sre: scaling eu-west-a node group now. k8s autoscaler triggered additional pods, tracking.

pagerduty: Acknowledgement recorded by eric_sre at 1799998889.

jane_platform: after route change, failure rate for synth-canary-eu-west dropped to <1% within 90s. Observability: no customer-facing 5xx spikes detected in user routes during the window.

alex_prodeng: good — sounds contained. We should still run a quick canary of the runtime config rollback in staging then prod rollback if confirmed.

eric_sre: agreed. I will revert the recent config change for eu-west-a (`runtime-config:v2026-03-12` -> `v2026-03-11`) and monitor.

ops_lead: assign follow-up: lambda postmortem and decide whether to disable that synth check or adjust thresholds. owner: jane_platform. ETA for postmortem draft: today EOD.

maria_oncall: paging noise note: can we silence synth probe alerts until we've tuned backoff? it's causing noisy PD pages. suggest muting alert rule `synth-probe-5xx-rate` for 15m while we stabilize.

eric_sre: muting for 15m now. mute_id=mute-5582.

incident-bot: :memo: Summary: initial page due to 90%+ 5xx on canary `canary-eu-west-7` caused by runtime eu-west-a OOMs after recent config change. Mitigations: route probe traffic to eu-west-b, scale eu-west-a, mute noisy alert, plan rollback of config. No broad customer 5xx impact observed; isolated latency elevation for a subset. Postmortem owner: jane_platform.

alex_prodeng: nice quick recovery. log entries and stack traces saved to https://go/logs/incident/1799998888. please attach any traces to the PM.

jane_platform: will do. I'll include timeline and mitigation steps + config delta in the postmortem.

maria_oncall: unmuting alert in 12m unless we need more time.

eric_sre: last check: runtime pods on eu-west-a are healthy, GC/OOM exceptions stopped after scale/rollback. marking incident as resolved on my side.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: PagerDuty incident #PD-83421 marked resolved by eric_sre at 1799998925.

ops_lead: thanks team. follow-up: postmortem due today EOD, assign action items for config validation before rollouts.

maria_oncall: thanks all. closing thread and handing to jane_platform for PM and next steps.
